name: threadwork-software-www
description: Corporate site for Threadwork Software, Inc. Astro v6 + Tailwind CSS v4, deployed to GitHub Pages.

scripts.check: npm run check:astro && npm run check:eslint && npm run check:prettier
scripts.fix: npm run fix:eslint && npm run fix:prettier

comments.vite-pin: One Vite, forced. @tailwindcss/vite accepts Vite 8, which is rolldown-based, while astro 6.4.8 resolves Vite 7.3.6. Left alone, npm installs both and the Tailwind plugin runs against the rolldown resolver, so every build dies with 'Missing field tsconfigPaths on BindingViteResolvePluginConfig.resolveOptions'. openscorm/www only avoids this because its lockfile predates the Vite 8 release, not because its versions are safer. Lift the override when Astro itself moves to Vite 8.
comments.tailwind-pin: tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/vite are exact, not caret-ranged, so a patch bump cannot quietly change which Vite major the plugin wants.
